documents.title: Arbor Transit fiscal Q2 regulatory filing
documents.body: Consolidated statement of operations. Fiscal Q2 net revenue as reported: $184 million. The company estimated $192 million in sales for fiscal Q3 in its planning discussion. The filing does not attribute the quarter's growth to a single driver.

documents.title: Arbor Transit fiscal Q2 earnings call transcript
documents.body: CEO, prepared remarks: Our primary fiscal Q2 revenue growth driver was fleet contract renewals. Analyst question: Could municipal grant timing have played a larger role? CEO: That was not the main driver. CFO, outlook: The $192 million figure is our fiscal Q3 outlook.

documents.title: Market Ledger Arbor Transit fiscal Q2 preview and commentary
documents.body: Market Ledger compiled a pre-release revenue consensus of $179 million from 11 analyst estimates. This was an expectations snapshot created before the issuer reported. Our writer had expected municipal grant timing to be the main growth driver.
